item.title: Yukhoe Sashimi and a DIY Malatang
item.description: Dinner was yuksashimi — sliced raw beef eaten with sesame oil, garlic and green chilli — alongside a malatang cooked at home. Good ingredients, not quite enough broth.

item.title: Samgyeopsal and Beef Sirloin for Lunch, with a Mountain of Minari
item.description: Grilling samgyeopsal and beef sirloin at home, starting at lunch. Half the pan is minari. Onion, potato and a pot of stew on the side, and no drinks today.
